name: Prompt Potion Runner
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
